items.title: Senior Accountant - Fiat & EMI Entities
items.description: Remote | EU/EEA or UK | Crypto & Payments | EMI Accounting | Full-time Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The company is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU and is now expanding its fiat business through new e-money licences in the EU and the UK. The culture is high-ownership and low-bureaucracy, with fast decisions and no micromanagement. About the role This is a senior, hands-on accounting role with a clear mandate: own the books of the company’s fiat entities, from licence to steady state. You will take end-to-end ownership of four entities: two e-money institutions in the EU and the UK that are in the licensing pipeline, plus fiat entities in the US and Canada. For the new EMIs, the first months are about building accounting properly from an empty ledger. Safeguarding and prudential requirements apply from the first day of trading, and volumes ramp quickly once licences land. If you want to set up EMI accounting from scratch rather than run a finished process, this role is built for you. You will report to the Accounting and Financial Reporting Lead and work as an individual contributor within a small accounting team. Each accountant owns specific legal entities end to end, and responsibilities do not overlap. What you will own - Entity accounting: day-to-day accounting for four fiat entities in Xero (multi-currency), from set-up through steady state. - New entity set-up: chart of accounts, bank mapping, close calendar and statutory and tax filing calendar for each newly licensed entity. - EMI accounting and reporting: safeguarding and client-money reconciliations designed with Treasury, inputs for own-funds and capital-adequacy calculations, and EMI regulatory returns to the national regulator and the FCA, end to end. - Month-end close: for every entity, covering bank reports mapped by counterparty and intercompany, accruals, prepayments, loans, payroll entries and FX revaluation. - Intercompany: recording and reconciling heavy intercompany flows with Treasury, and supporting transfer pricing documentation. - Local statutory and tax compliance: EU and UK annual accounts, VAT and statistical reporting, Companies House and HMRC deadlines, and year-end inputs for the US and Canada. You will prepare the data and own the filing calendar, working with external tax advisers. - Invoice control: checking that supplier invoices meet local tax requirements before payment. - Audit and group reporting: consolidation inputs, audit schedules and auditor queries for your entities. - Management accounts: monthly entity-level accounts, analytical review of P&L and balance-sheet movements, and investigation of unusual items before close sign-off. - Process build: documented close procedures and controls for each new entity, designed to scale after licensing. What we are looking for - Hands-on accounting experience for a live EMI in the EU or UK. This includes EMI regulatory returns you owned end to end and safeguarding or client-money reconciliations you ran yourself, not through an outsourced provider. - Experience producing own-funds or capital-requirement inputs for an EMI. - 5+ years of in-house accounting with independent general ledger ownership and month-end close. - Strong IFRS (UK GAAP / FRS 102 accepted) and a working understanding of US GAAP simplifications. You can analyse new transactions, decide the accounting treatment and document your position. - Multi-entity, multi-currency accounting, including intercompany reconciliation, FX revaluation and group consolidation (eliminations, foreign-currency translation). - Strong balance-sheet ownership: account reconciliations, ageing analysis, investigation of unreconciled items and balance substantiation. - Experience reconciling high-volume payment data to bank accounts and the general ledger. - A fintech or payments background. - A builder mindset: comfortable setting up processes from scratch rather than expecting them to be in place. - Fluent English. - Existing right to work and residence in the EU/EEA or the UK. Nice to have - Latvian statutory and tax knowledge (VAT, statistical reports, benefits in kind) or Latvian language. - Experience setting up accounting for a newly licensed EMI or PI. - Experience running a multi-country filing calendar with external tax advisers. - Xero, plus ERP or reconciliation tooling. - Exposure to crypto or to international groups with heavy intercompany flows. - Big 4 or audit background. What’s on offer - End-to-end ownership of four entities, including building EMI accounting from day one. - A fully remote setup, with a flat structure, fast decisions and trust-based ways of working. - 20 paid working days of annual leave, paid sick leave and health insurance. - Professional development opportunities, team events and an English course. - A fast, transparent hiring process.

items.description: Remote or hybrid | Europe (CET/EET time zone) | Crypto & Payments | Treasury & Payment Operations | Employment or B2B Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The company is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU and is expanding its licence footprint, including new e-money authorisations. The culture is owner-led, high-ownership and low-bureaucracy: decisions are made quickly and close to the founders. About the role This is a hands-on Treasury Manager role in the Finance & Treasury team, reporting to the Head of Treasury. Money moves every day across dozens of bank accounts, payment providers, acquirers, exchange venues and wallets, in several currencies and jurisdictions. Your job is to make sure it is in the right place, in the right amount, at the right time, and that the company can prove it to an auditor or a regulator. You will take full ownership of operational payments, build regular cash and crypto reporting for Finance leadership, and get safeguarding reconciliation ready for the company’s upcoming e-money licences. This is an individual contributor role with real ownership: you will not just run existing processes, you will help redesign them. What you will own - Operational payments: the end-to-end invoice and salary payment cycle, including validation, approval routing, FX and release across banks and EMIs, as well as beneficiary verification, dual authorisation, returns and stuck payments. - Payment process redesign: working with Finance leadership to build a faster, well-controlled payment process: higher payment frequency, invoice checks with accounting before payment, backup approvers and the four-eyes principle kept at all times. - Cash and crypto reporting: collecting balances across banks, acquirers, PSPs, exchanges and custody accounts, and producing a signed-off cash flow report with analytics on changes in cash and crypto positions. - Safeguarding and segregation: daily safeguarding reconciliation for e-money entities once operational, and client-asset segregation and reconciliation under MiCA and PSD2, with records that stand up to review. - Regulatory and audit support: recurring returns for licensed entities and the treasury evidence pack for audit and regulator requests. - Liquidity: short-term forecasting, pre-funding of settlement and trading accounts, sweeps, and stablecoin and hot/cold float management in line with policy. - Controls and improvement: treasury policies, authority matrices and SOPs, and moving reporting and reconciliation off spreadsheets together with Finance Systems and Engineering. What we are looking for - 3–5 years in treasury or payment operations, ideally at a crypto or fintech company. - Hands-on payment execution in a company role: approval workflows, banking portals, payment file formats and segregation of duties. - Real crypto operations experience: exchange and custody accounts, stablecoin settlement, hot/cold wallet operations, on-chain verification, and network specifics such as fees, finality, memo/tag and stuck transactions. - Ownership of regular balance reporting and reconciliation in a multi-currency, multi-account environment, including resolving breaks. - Experience in a regulated environment: regulatory reporting, safeguarding or client-money rules, and audit or regulator requests. - Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. - Exceptional attention to detail, precision under cut-off pressure and full discretion with sensitive financial information. - Fluent English. - Based in a time zone close to CET/EET. Nice to have - Hands-on PSD2 or EMI safeguarding reconciliation, including UK safeguarding. - MiCA/CASP crypto-asset segregation and reporting. - Experience redesigning a payment or approval process together with accounting. - Building cash flow reports and dashboards; SQL beyond the basics. - Fireblocks or a similar custody/MPC platform. - A treasury certification such as ACT or CTP. What’s on offer - Full ownership of treasury operations in a regulated crypto and payments business. - A role where you shape processes and controls, not just follow them. - A remote setup, or hybrid at the company’s European HQ, with a flat structure and fast decisions. - A full-time contract with a performance bonus. - Paid leave, health insurance and a certification budget. - A clear hiring process: HR interview, a joint interview with Treasury and Finance leadership, and a reference check. Because the role involves access to company accounts, a pre-employment background check follows the offer.

items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Our Inference team brings OpenAI’s most capable research and technology to the world through our products. You will own performance across the full forward pass, from model code through kernels to execution on the hardware. We welcome experience gained through either training or inference, with a strong foundation in optimizing real workloads on TPUs. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The group is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU, is registered in Canada, and is expanding its licence footprint in Europe and the UK. Its US entity is registered with FinCEN as a Money Services Business. The culture is owner-led, high-ownership and low-bureaucracy: decisions are made quickly and close to the founders. You will report to the Board and work closely with the Global Chief Compliance Officer on framework and policy. The BSA/AML and OFAC programme is already in place: policies, risk assessment, SAR process, sanctions screening, training records and an independent review. Your mission is to keep it examination-ready on any given day and to raise it to the standard that supports US growth with banking partners, card acquirers and new integrations. You will make filing, exit and escalation decisions independently. What you will own - BSA/AML and OFAC programme: policies, procedures, enterprise-wide risk assessment, training and alignment with the group compliance framework, including where US law requires a stricter control. - Monitoring and investigations: fiat and on-chain transaction monitoring, alert disposition, investigation standards and case documentation. - SAR decisions: drafting, approving and filing SARs within the 30-day timeline, continuing-activity reviews, and SAR confidentiality. - Sanctions: OFAC screening across customers, counterparties, wallet addresses and geolocation; match adjudication; blocked and rejected transaction reporting; crypto-specific sanctions typologies. - Information requests: 314(a) responses, subpoenas and law-enforcement requests, and 314(b) information sharing. - Customer and partner risk: KYC/EDD standards, customer risk rating, approval of high-risk and PEP relationships, and exit decisions. - Vendor oversight: due diligence, configuration and performance of KYC, screening and blockchain-analytics vendors. - Product review: BSA/OFAC assessment of new products, payment methods and partner integrations before launch. - Examinations and assurance: IRS BSA examinations, FinCEN inquiries, sponsor-bank audits and the independent review, with evidence-based remediation of findings. - Registration and governance: FinCEN MSB registration and Board reporting on programme status, filings, findings and emerging risk. Nice to have - Previous BSA Officer role at a crypto exchange, VASP or crypto-native MSB. - Hands-on blockchain analytics experience: Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM, Scorechain or equivalent. - Direct experience with an IRS BSA examination or a FinCEN inquiry. - Sponsor-bank or banking-partner relationship management for an MSB. - Visa/Mastercard crypto programme and acquirer compliance exposure. - State money transmitter licensing experience. - Experience presenting to a Board, audit committee or regulator. - Exposure to cross-border compliance in the EU (MiCA), UK or Canada. - CAMS, CCAS, CFE, CRCM or a comparable qualification. What’s on offer - A statutory role with real authority, direct Board access and documented independence. - Real ownership: you run the US programme and shape how it supports the company’s growth. - A remote setup within the US, with periodic in-person time at the European HQ.

Perform large-scale Monte Carlo simulations, validate theoretical and simulated RTP, and evaluate statistical reliability through variance analysis, confidence intervals, and convergence testing - Prepare mathematical documentation, including PAR sheets, RTP calculations, and supporting materials required for independent testing and certification - Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of an internal math development and simulation framework, participating in architectural discussions, technical reviews, and implementation - Evaluate live game performance data, identify potential improvements, and provide mathematical recommendations for existing and upcoming releases - Partner with producers, game designers, and developers to assess new mechanics, balance gameplay experience, and address mathematical or technical risks - Help establish consistent math development standards, share technical knowledge, and support the professional growth of other mathematicians Requirements - 5+ years of professional experience in slot game mathematics within a game provider or development studio, rather than an operator - Track record of at least 10 commercially released slot titles, preferably including games with demonstrated market success - Extensive knowledge of probability, combinatorics, and statistical modelling, with the ability to apply these principles to complex slot mechanics - Proven ability to build complete mathematical models around defined targets, including RTP, volatility, hit rate, maximum exposure, payout distribution, and feature contribution - Advanced experience in mathematical validation and high-volume simulations, including analytical RTP verification, Monte Carlo methods involving billions of spins, variance analysis, confidence intervals, and convergence assessment - Familiarity with gaming certification standards and testing procedures, including requirements associated with GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, iTech Labs, and preparation of mathematical reports and PAR sheets - Ability to independently manage mathematical development throughout the complete game lifecycle, from initial design to final certification - Degree in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related discipline, preferably at Master's level or above - Previous involvement in building or improving proprietary slot math engines or simulation frameworks - Knowledge of mathematical optimization techniques, including genetic algorithms, simulated annealing, and linear programming, for automated adjustment of reels and paytables - Experience designing mathematical models for crash games, instant-win products, or other alternative gaming formats - Understanding of the interaction between mathematical models, game clients, and backend systems - Fluent English for technical documentation, collaboration with international stakeholders, and communication with testing laboratories or regulators - Proficiency in at least one programming language: Python, C++, C#, Rust, Java, or Go - Experience developing high-performance simulation software, including multithreading, performance optimization, and large-scale data processing - Opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative iGaming products and influence key technical decisions - Work on challenging projects involving advanced game mathematics and simulation technologies - Opportunities for professional development and career growth - Collaboration with experienced professionals in a supportive, knowledge-sharing environment

items.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Platform Safety
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Platform Safety builds the infrastructure that lets Anthropic bring its most capable models to more people, safely and securely. Our systems decide both who can access our most advanced models, and what capabilities they can access, wherever Claude is available. That includes identity and business verification, trusted access programs, and the core services that grant, hold and enforce model access across our products. These systems already power the Cyber Verification Program, which now includes Project Glasswing, and the Life Sciences Verification Program with further more advanced use cases in development. As a Staff+ engineer, you'll help set the technical direction for this work. The foundations are live and adoption is growing quickly, so the next challenge is scale: making access a matter of configuration instead of code, making verification reusable, and giving customers a consistent experience on every surface. You'll work closely with safeguards, product, design and research to turn safety policy into systems that are easy to use and enforce. You'll also take new 0 → 1 efforts from idea to delivery as new capabilities and programs emerge. What you'll do You'll design, build and operate the systems that decide who gets access to our most capable models. You'll build the platform that lets teams across Anthropic launch and run trusted access programs, moving access rules out of code and into data so that launching a new model or complex program is simple and scalable. You'll build out our identity and business verification system (KYC/KYB) as a reusable service that any program can use, which means integrating verification vendors, protecting sensitive personal data, expanding into new regions, and building fair review and appeal paths for customers. You'll also evolve the core services behind every access decision, including the services that grant and hold access and the customer and user identity models they rely on, and keep them highly available and consistent across our own products and cloud platforms. You'll shape the architecture through clear written proposals, review key designs, and mentor engineers on a growing team. You'll also share on-call, lead incident response, and support emerging new programs. You might be a good fit if you: Have a minimum of 8 years of practical experience as a backend or platform engineer, ideally at tech lead level or equivalent, and are comfortable working across the stack when the problem calls for it Have strong product sense, and work closely with cross-functional partners, including non-engineers, to shape and execute strategy in new domains Use AI tools as a regular part of how you design, build and review software Have designed and operated production distributed systems on a critical path, where correctness, latency and availability all matter Take full ownership of your work, from design through build, deployment, operations and iteration Navigate ambiguity and make sound technical decisions independently, have set technical direction that other engineers and teams adopted, and have ideally operated in both 0 → 1 and more mature settings Care about building robust, scalable systems that other engineers and businesses love to use Care about the societal impacts of your work and Anthropic's mission to build safe, beneficial AI Strong candidates may also have: Identity, access control or authorization systems at scale Fraud, risk, trust and safety, or KYC/KYB systems, including working with verification vendors Regulated or compliance-sensitive environments, including handling sensitive personal data Integrating with cloud platforms or partner ecosystems such as AWS, Google Cloud and Azure Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on formal methods. You will design, train, and deploy SOTA large language models and apply them to diverse use cases. You'll work cross-functionally with internal and external science, engineering, and product teams to deliver high-impact AI solutions. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art models on large clusters. - Generate and curate datasets for theorem proving and software verification, and build evaluators and benchmarks for formal reasoning. - Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases. - Manage research projects and communications with client research teams. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Fluent in English with excellent communication skills — at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. - Expert with PyTorch or JAX. - Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance. - Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code. - Doesn’t need roadmaps: moves independently and navigates uncertainty with confidence. - Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn. - Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia. NICE TO HAVE - PhD / Master in a relevant field (Computer Science, Mathematics, Machine Learning). - Experience with autoformalization, proof automation, or verified code generation. - Experience with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards, ideally from Lean or other proof assistants. - Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase. - Publications in top academic journals or conferences. - Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Director, Enterprise IT
items.description: Help Us Build The Future of Travel At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK. Contract: Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain) UK: Full-time, permanent Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async. Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most: Life at Airalo · España: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-espana Life at Airalo · United Kingdom: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-united-kingdom Why People Join Us 🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first. Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact. For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home. 🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers. Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one. As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane. Before You Hit Apply By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process. items.title: Senior Product Manager, Advisor Marketplace
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers, sharp problem-solvers, and builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency – it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Advisory Products team is redefining the advisor experience by bringing the best of Robinhood’s technology, design, and infrastructure to Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs) and the clients they serve. Following our TradePMR acquisition, we’re building a modern advisor platform – custody, tools, and a two-sided marketplace that connects Robinhood’s investors with trusted, growth-oriented advisors. As the Product Manager for the Advisor Marketplace, you will own the product that helps investors find, meet, and fund accounts with the right advisor – and helps advisors win and onboard those clients efficiently. You’ll own the full marketplace funnel, from demand generation and matching through first meeting, onboarding, and funded account, and you’ll use data and experimentation to make every step work better for both sides. This is an opportunity to take a new, high-visibility business from early traction to scale, in close partnership with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Operations, and Compliance. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Advisor Marketplace, balancing the needs of both sides – investors looking for advice and advisors looking to grow their practices. Own the end-to-end marketplace funnel – discovery, matching and routing, scheduling, first-meeting show rate, advisor onboarding, and funded accounts – and drive measurable improvements at each stage. Define and manage marketplace health: supply and demand balance, advisor quality and standards, lead allocation, and conversion, with clear metrics such as meetings booked and completed, accounts funded, assets under management, and net flows. Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data Science to ship products from concept to production, using research, experimentation, and analytics to guide prioritization and measure success. Work with Compliance, Legal, and Risk to embed regulatory and operational requirements directly into product design, advisor vetting, disclosures, and workflows. Integrate the marketplace with the broader RIA platform, including TradePMR and Robinhood’s app, so that advisor and client data, accounts, and custody flows connect seamlessly. Drive go-to-market execution with Marketing, Sales, and Operations across launches, advisor acquisition and onboarding, support readiness, and cross-functional communication. Explore how AI can improve the client experience when working with an advisor. Stay ahead of trends in wealth management, advisor technology, and marketplaces to inform long-term strategy. What you bring 4+ years of product management experience, including building and launching marketplace, platform, or complex multi-sided products, ideally in fintech, brokerage, or wealth management. Demonstrated success owning a funnel or growth-oriented product end-to-end, with a track record of improving conversion and engagement through experimentation and analytics. Experience delivering products in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment, balancing innovation with operational and regulatory rigor. Strong analytical skills: you define success metrics, write your own queries or dashboards, and use data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement. Strong technical acumen and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, and operations teams on system design, integrations, and scalability. Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to align diverse stakeholders – including executives, advisors, and partner teams – around a shared roadmap. An ownership mindset and a scrappy, self-starter attitude: comfortable with ambiguity, able to define what “great” looks like as you go. Passion for empowering financial advisors and their clients, and for transforming the wealth management industry through modern technology. Bonus points Experience building two-sided marketplaces, lead-generation or referral products, or CRM and scheduling workflows. Experience shipping AI-enabled features in B2B or consumer products. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Best-in-class benefits, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Lifestyle wallet – a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge, including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $166,000 — $195,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $146,000 — $172,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $129,000 — $152,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: VIP Relationship Manager, LATAM
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Our VIP team supports the firm's highest-value private clients across the Payward ecosystem: high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) who expect a premium, secure, and highly tailored experience. We ensure Kraken remains the platform of choice for VIPs by delivering white-glove relationship management, personalized trading enablement, and high-impact benefits. We are looking for a VIP Relationship Manager, LATAM to help us scale our VIP client book and growth across the region. This is a hybrid role: part white-glove relationship management, part growth and business development. You'll build Kraken's presence inside LATAM's VIP trading and investor communities, run local marketing and events, and source new whale relationships. We're looking for someone who isn't afraid to be bold, can build and scale initiatives from the ground up, and is humble enough to fail fast and move on to the next challenge. If you thrive in ambiguity and can operate in a fast-paced, scrappy environment, this role is for you. THE OPPORTUNITY - Serve as the trusted point of contact for Kraken and Payward’s top private clients across LATAM, delivering consistent, high-quality white-glove service and building deep, durable relationships. - Own the regional VIP book end to end: onboarding, tier progression, retention, and proactive intervention on at-risk and lapsing clients. - Build lasting relationships that grow AOP, net deposits, and trading volume, your primary KPIs, by becoming the partner clients trust with more of their capital and activity over time. - Bring Kraken's private client and VIP offerings to market locally, including yield and earn campaigns, lending against tokenized equities and crypto collateral, OTC execution, and structured private-client benefits, ensuring they remain impactful and competitive against regional exchanges and desks. - Source and convert new HNWI relationships through direct outreach, referrals, and introducer networks, from crypto-wealthy individuals and family offices to the principals of trading firms, OTC desks, miners, and project treasuries. - Get inside LATAM's VIP trading communities: private trading groups, investor clubs, KOL and trader networks, and closed-door investor groups. Be the Kraken face those communities know and trust. - Design and run local marketing and events (VIP dinners, trader meetups, conference-adjacent programming, and co-marketing with regional partners and KOLs) in partnership with our Marketing and Regional teams. - Build and manage introducer and referral partnerships that produce a repeatable pipeline of qualified private clients. - Act as Payward’s ear on the ground: competitive intelligence on regional exchanges, product gaps that cost us whale business, and the local narratives that move capital. - Partner with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Banking, and Client Service to champion new efforts that drive private client growth and loyalty, and to make sure every play you run is inside Kraken's licensing and compliance perimeter. WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of experience in relationship management, account management, private banking, brokerage, or private client sales, including at least 2 years in the crypto space, with a track record of working with HNWIs. - An existing, personal network among LATAM's crypto HNWIs, traders, family offices, OTC desks, funds, or trading communities in Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, or Chile. - Demonstrated ability to originate business, not just service it. You have personally brought in clients, run events, or built a community presence that produced measurable pipeline. - Deep understanding of trading product solutions, including spot, margin, and futures trading, as well as OTC trading, lending, and yield/earn products. Familiarity with how deposits and client balances drive an exchange's lending economics is a strong plus. - Comfort operating in a regulated environment across multiple LATAM jurisdictions, and the judgment to know when to involve Compliance early. - Highly data-driven, with expertise in analyzing KPIs such as assets on platform, net deposits, trading volume, and client portfolio revenue. - Ability to be scrappy, bold, and unafraid to explore alternative and creative solutions to achieve results. - Deep knowledge of cryptocurrency ecosystems, their players, frameworks, and market dynamics beyond just blue-chip tokens, including how local on/off-ramps and stablecoin flows shape client behavior in the region. - Skilled at building meaningful partnerships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels and across diverse backgrounds. - Willingness to travel up to 30% across the region for client meetings, events, and conferences. - Based in Brazil and native or near-native Portuguese plus fluent English required. Spanish is a strong plus. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Developer Platform
items.description: About MoonPay MoonPay is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. Recent recognition: Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. About the Opportunity MoonPay is building a developer platform that allows partners to create native payment and crypto experiences directly inside their own products. Historically, partners integrated MoonPay through a hosted widget and redirected users into a fixed MoonPay journey. We are now breaking the underlying system into reusable modules covering authentication, identity, KYC, quotes, payment methods and purchasing. These capabilities are exposed through APIs, SDKs, embedded components, iframes and web views. Our goal is for a partner developer to integrate MoonPay’s full capabilities without needing ongoing implementation support from our team. This role owns the developer-facing layer between MoonPay’s underlying payments infrastructure and the products our partners build. You will work across browsers, mobile applications and backend APIs to make complex financial workflows feel simple, predictable and native. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. You will build the platform itself rather than implementing one-off integrations for individual customers. Build the developer platform Design and build APIs, SDKs and embedded components used by external developers. Turn MoonPay’s existing authentication, identity, payment and purchasing capabilities into reusable platform modules. Develop secure browser and mobile integration patterns across iframes, web views and native applications. Create stable abstractions over complex payments, compliance and crypto infrastructure. Build reference applications, sandboxes and tooling that help developers move quickly from exploration to production. Understand the integration deeply Own the complete developer journey, from obtaining credentials through to completing a live transaction. Design clear interfaces for sessions, authentication, quotes, payment methods, transaction state and errors. Handle the realities of browser and mobile environments, including cross-origin communication, redirects, storage restrictions and application lifecycle events. Develop consistent behaviour across web, iOS and Android integrations. Ensure integrations remain secure when operating inside products MoonPay does not control. Make complex systems easy to use Design APIs and SDKs that are difficult to misuse and straightforward to debug. Establish clear versioning, compatibility and migration strategies. Build documentation around how developers actually use the platform rather than treating it as a secondary deliverable. Create useful errors, logs and observability so partners can resolve issues without contacting MoonPay. Reduce integration time and the amount of direct support required from engineering. Operate payment-critical software Build systems where failures can prevent a customer from completing a purchase or leave a partner uncertain about transaction state. Design for retries, duplicate events, delayed responses and dependencies failing in unexpected ways. Implement idempotency, state recovery and graceful degradation across distributed payment flows. Measure API and SDK adoption, integration success, reliability and developer experience. Safely evolve the platform as MoonPay adds products, payment methods, regions and partners. About You Must-have experience and skills External developer products. You have built APIs, SDKs, embedded components or integration tooling used by third-party developers. Browser or mobile depth. You understand how browsers and mobile applications behave beneath the framework level, including sessions, storage, cross-origin communication and embedded experiences. JavaScript and TypeScript. You have strong language fundamentals and have built production client-side or SDK infrastructure. API and SDK design. You understand versioning, backwards compatibility, documentation, error design and safe migrations. Distributed systems. You build correctly when events arrive twice, late or out of order and when dependencies fail. Product judgement. You can turn complex platform capabilities into interfaces that developers can understand and adopt. Ownership. You have taken developer-facing software from design through launch, adoption and ongoing production support. Nice-to-have experience Built payment APIs, checkout SDKs, embedded financial products or payment-method integrations. Built products similar to Stripe Elements, Stripe.js, Plaid Link or Braintree’s client SDKs. Experience with secure iframes, web views, postMessage or cross-origin browser infrastructure. Developed SDKs across web, iOS or Android. Built sandboxes, test environments, reference applications or developer documentation. Experience with webhooks, idempotency, transaction state machines and payment orchestration. Worked on authentication, identity or KYC integrations. Familiarity with cryptocurrency, wallets or digital-asset products. Familiarity with our stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, GCP, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kubernetes. Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. About the Opportunity MoonPay is building a unified identity and KYC platform that can support customers across ramps, cards, virtual accounts and enterprise products. Today, many financial products treat identity as part of a single onboarding flow. We are building it as a reusable platform capability: a secure identity layer that allows customers to verify once, maintain control of their information and access different MoonPay-powered products without repeating the same journey each time. This role will help define the architecture and technical direction of that platform. You will work across product, engineering, compliance and security to determine how identity is captured, verified, stored, linked and exposed safely through APIs and SDKs. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. The problem is not fully defined, and we are looking for someone who can shape the platform while building its most important components. Lead through ambiguity Turn a broad identity and KYC vision into a clear technical strategy, architecture and sequence of deliverable work. Identify the boundaries between identity, authentication, verification, compliance and product-specific onboarding. Set the technical bar through rigorous reviews, clear standards and lasting engineering habits. Align teams across ramps, cards, virtual accounts and enterprise products around a shared identity model. Build the identity platform Design a unified identity layer that can support multiple MoonPay products, partners and regulated use cases. Model the lifecycle of a customer’s identity, including creation, verification, linking, updates, consent and deletion. Build secure APIs and SDKs that allow internal teams and external partners to use identity capabilities without understanding the underlying complexity. Integrate KYC and identity-verification providers while keeping MoonPay’s internal model consistent and extensible. Develop clear ownership boundaries between the identity platform and the products built on top of it. Protect sensitive customer data Define how identity data is stored, accessed and shared across products, jurisdictions and legal entities. Design for consent, auditability, data residency, retention and deletion from the beginning. Build clear authorisation controls around who and what can access verified customer information. Ensure the platform degrades safely when external verification providers or internal dependencies fail. Partner closely with Security, Privacy, Legal and Compliance without allowing the platform to become difficult for developers to use. Create a platform developers trust Build public-facing APIs, SDKs and documentation that make complex identity workflows straightforward to integrate. Establish stable contracts, versioning strategies and migration paths for teams and partners using the platform. Provide observability into identity journeys, verification decisions and integration failures. Reduce the need for product teams to rebuild identity and KYC logic independently. About You Must-have experience and skills Identity platform experience. You have built or owned production identity, KYC, authentication or customer-data infrastructure used across multiple products. Platform architecture. You have defined shared technical foundations rather than delivering only a single onboarding or login experience. Public APIs and SDKs. You have built interfaces used by external developers and understand stability, versioning, documentation and backwards compatibility. Sensitive data. You understand the security, privacy and operational requirements involved in storing and processing identity information. Systems thinking. You can reason across data models, verification providers, product workflows, compliance requirements and failure modes. Ambiguity and influence. You have taken a problem nobody had fully scoped, created a technical direction and brought multiple teams with you. Hands-on engineering. You continue to design, build, review and operate production systems rather than leading only through documents and meetings. Nice-to-have experience Built identity or KYC infrastructure within payments, fintech, banking or another regulated environment. Experience with reusable verified identity, identity vaults or portable customer profiles. Experience with OAuth, OIDC, WebAuthn, passkeys, session management or account recovery. Built systems supporting consent, data residency, privacy requests and audit trails. Worked with multiple KYC, KYB or identity-verification providers. Experience building developer platforms for external partners. Familiarity with cryptocurrency, wallets or digital-asset products. Familiarity with our stack: TypeScript, Node.js, GCP, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kubernetes. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. items.title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t. We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery. Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality. Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk. Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season. Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process. items.title: CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager
items.description: Better Collective is looking for an experienced CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager to establish and lead a group-wide approach to customer relationship management across our portfolio of global sports media brands. This is a senior role combining CRM strategy, customer lifecycle management, technology, data, commercial thinking and operational leadership . The successful candidate will move CRM beyond campaign execution and develop it as a strategic capability that helps Better Collective build deeper, more valuable relationships with its audiences. Working across Product, Audience, Data, Commercial, Editorial, Technology and local brand teams, the CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will create the frameworks, programmes and operating model required to turn first- and zero-party audience data into personalised customer experiences and measurable business value. The Opportunity Better Collective reaches millions of sports fans across a diverse portfolio of digital brands. The next stage of our audience strategy is to develop stronger direct relationships with those users — moving from anonymous audiences → known users → understood customers → engaged and valuable relationships . CRM will be central to that transformation. The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will establish the strategy, capabilities and standards that allow Better Collective brands to acquire, activate, engage, retain and monetise audiences across the customer lifecycle. Key Responsibilities CRM Strategy & Leadership Develop Better Collective's group-wide CRM and lifecycle strategy. Establish CRM principles, standards and best practices across brands. Create a scalable operating model balancing central CRM expertise with local brand execution. Identify where CRM can deliver the greatest audience and commercial impact. Build CRM roadmaps for priority Better Collective brands. Act as the senior CRM subject-matter expert across the organisation. Customer Lifecycle Management Design lifecycle strategies covering: Acquisition → Registration → Onboarding → Engagement → Conversion → Retention → Reactivation Develop automated programmes including: Welcome and onboarding journeys Profile completion Content discovery Personalised sports and player updates Newsletter engagement Subscription conversion Premium product promotion Renewal Retention Churn prevention Lapsed-user reactivation Win-back programmes The objective is to create relevant, personalised experiences rather than simply increase communication volume. First & Zero-Party Data Activation Work closely with Audience, Product and Data teams to translate Better Collective's growing first- and zero-party data capabilities into meaningful customer experiences. Use behavioural, declared and transactional data to improve: Audience segmentation Personalisation Content recommendations Lifecycle triggers Subscription propensity Retention Cross-sell opportunities Audience insight Help establish the connection between data capture, customer understanding and CRM activation . Multi-Channel CRM Develop a coordinated CRM approach across: Email Newsletters App push Web push In-app messaging On-site messaging Emerging direct audience channels Establish channel roles, contact strategies, frequency management and customer communication principles. Ensure customers receive coordinated experiences rather than disconnected messages from individual channels. CRM Technology & Automation Partner with Product and Technology teams to maximise Better Collective's CRM technology stack. Responsibilities include: Marketing automation Journey orchestration Audience segmentation Triggered communications Dynamic content Personalisation CRM/CDP integration Data flows Preference management Testing frameworks Reporting requirements Help translate business and customer requirements into practical technology capabilities. Measurement & Optimisation Create a consistent CRM measurement framework across Better Collective. Core metrics should include: Known-user growth Registration conversion Newsletter acquisition Email engagement Push engagement Active-user frequency Subscription conversion Renewal Retention Reactivation Revenue per known user Customer lifetime value Move CRM measurement beyond opens and clicks toward customer behaviour and commercial outcomes . Experimentation Establish a structured CRM experimentation programme covering: A/B testing Send frequency Timing Content Segmentation Personalisation Offers Lifecycle triggers Channel combinations Create mechanisms for successful experiments to be documented and scaled across Better Collective brands. Stakeholder Leadership CRM at Better Collective sits across multiple disciplines. The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will therefore work closely with: Audience — audience strategy, segmentation and zero/first-party data Product — registration, logged-in experiences and product journeys Data & BI — customer data, segmentation and measurement Technology — CRM platforms, integrations and automation Editorial — content propositions and newsletters Commercial — monetisation and customer value Subscription Teams — acquisition, renewal and retention Compliance — consent, GDPR, PECR and data governance Strong stakeholder leadership will be critical to the success of the role. We are looking for an experienced CRM leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to turn strategy into operational programmes. The successful candidate will ideally have: Significant experience leading CRM, lifecycle or customer engagement programmes. Strong knowledge of email marketing and marketing automation. Experience developing sophisticated customer lifecycle strategies. Strong understanding of customer segmentation and personalisation. Experience working with large customer databases. Experience using behavioural and transactional data to improve communications. Strong understanding of CRM technology and platform capabilities. Experience working across Product, Data, Technology, Marketing and Commercial teams. Excellent stakeholder management skills. Experience managing CRM teams, agencies or specialist partners. Strong analytical and commercial mindset. Demonstrable experience connecting CRM activity to measurable business outcomes. Experience within digital media, subscriptions, publishing, sports, gaming or high-frequency digital consumer products would be particularly valuable. Leadership Profile The role requires someone who can operate at both strategic and practical levels. You should be comfortable moving between: Strategy ↔ Execution Customer ↔ Commercial Data ↔ Communications Technology ↔ Marketing Central Strategy ↔ Local Brand Requirements You will need to influence senior stakeholders while also being comfortable working directly with teams responsible for delivering CRM programmes. What Success Looks Like First 3 Months Audit CRM capabilities across priority Better Collective brands. Establish baseline CRM KPIs. Map existing lifecycle communications. Identify immediate optimisation opportunities. Define the group CRM strategy and operating principles. Prioritise brands and lifecycle use cases. 3–6 Months Launch priority automated lifecycle programmes. Establish group segmentation principles. Introduce a structured CRM experimentation framework. Establish CRM dashboards and commercial measurement. Develop CRM playbooks that can be reused across brands. 6–12 Months Better Collective has a scalable CRM capability connecting: Audience Data → Customer Insight → Segmentation → Personalisation → Activation → Measurement → Commercial Value CRM becomes a measurable growth engine supporting: Audience Engagement | Registration | Subscription | Retention | Revenue | Customer Lifetime Value Why This Role Matters Better Collective already has significant global audience scale. The opportunity is to build stronger direct relationships with those audiences. This role will help Better Collective transition from primarily understanding what audiences consume to understanding who our customers are, what they value and how we can build longer-lasting relationships with them . The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will be central to making that transition happen.

items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Research Engineer on the Latency & Throughput team, you will push the frontier of LLM inference by researching and prototyping techniques that reduce latency and increase throughput — from speculative decoding and quantization to KV compression and new attention variants. The team sits at the intersection of research and production: you will take ideas from recent literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and ship the techniques that prove out into our serving stack. This role sits between our inference engineers, who own the production serving stack, and our research scientists, who focus on paper-level contributions. You will be more science-focused than a pure engineer: you are expected to generate new ideas, keep up with the state of the art, and implement proof-of-concepts that bridge the gap between academic results and production impact. Some techniques you explore will be lossy or require integration into training — retraining models, tuning architectures, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. You will work closely with the Inference Foundation and Kernels teams, who turn your validated techniques into production recipes, and with pretraining and RL teams when your work touches model training. Success is measured by demonstrated latency or throughput gains, first at small scale, then adopted in production. What You Will Do - Research and prototype inference techniques — speculative decoding, quantization, KV compression, watermarking, and new model architectures — by reading recent literature and forming testable hypotheses. - Design and run experiments to validate or refute ideas, iterating quickly on small-scale setups before proposing production integration. Demonstrate clear latency or throughput gains without unacceptable quality loss. - Collaborate with the Inference Foundation team to integrate validated techniques into the vLLM-based serving stack. - Partner with pretraining and RL teams when techniques require co-training, retraining, or training auxiliary models to improve inference. Build the right tooling and validation platforms to facilitate AI-driven inference research. What We're Looking For - A strong ML background with solid knowledge of LLM training techniques — architecture, tokenization, fine-tuning, and evaluation. - Hands-on experience with Python and PyTorch; you write clean, experimental code and iterate fast. JAX is acceptable with strong Python proficiency. C++ and Rust are not required, CUDA and GPU knowledge is expected but hands-on experience is not required. - Research experience of some form: a thesis, publications, a dedicated research project, or efficiency-oriented work in a lab or industry research setting. A PhD is not required, but we are looking for genuine research depth. - A track record of conducting experiments: forming hypotheses, designing controlled comparisons, and drawing clear conclusions from results. - Familiarity with the state of the art in LLM inference — you know what has been tried, what works, and where the open problems are. - Self-starter, low-ego, and collaborative. You are comfortable with ambiguity, negative results, and are eager to take matters into your own hands. - Inference or serving experience is a plus, not a requirement. Prior work with vLLM, production LLM deployments, or serving systems will help you ramp up faster. Location and Remote This role is based in our Paris or London offices (hybrid). We will prioritize candidates who reside in the Paris area or are open to relocating. We strongly believe in the value of in-person collaboration to foster strong relationships and seamless communication within our team. For senior profiles, we will also consider remote candidates based in France. In that case, we ask all new hires to visit our Paris office: - For the first week of their onboarding (accommodation and travel covered) - Then at least 3 days per month WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.
